FILE_PROBES: list[tuple[str, str, list[str], int]] = [
    ("missing-file", "missing", ["CI 배선 불량"], 2),
    ("directory", "dir", ["CI 배선 불량"], 2),
    ("no-args", "none", [], 2),
    ("one-arg", "normal", None, 2),  # type: ignore[list-item]
    ("three-args", "normal", ["CI 배선 불량", "extra"], 2),
]


def clean_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_") and k not in {"BASH_ENV", "ENV"}}


def run(args: list[str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(HELPER), *args], cwd=ROOT, env=clean_env(), text=True,
                          capture_output=True, check=False)


def main() -> int:
    results = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hs0002-v2-final-adv-cli-") as tmp:
        for name, data, expected, wanted in PROBES:
            path = Path(tmp) / f"{name}.log"
            path.write_bytes(data)
            proc = run([str(path), expected])
            results.append({"name": name, "file_bytes": data.decode("utf-8", "backslashreplace"), "expected": expected,
                            "wanted_exit": wanted, "exit": proc.returncode, "stderr": proc.stderr.strip(),
                            "ok": proc.returncode == wanted})
        for name, kind, extra, wanted in FILE_PROBES:
            path = Path(tmp) / f"{name}-target"
            if kind == "dir":
                path.mkdir()
            elif kind == "normal":
                path.write_text("FAIL: CI 배선 불량\n", encoding="utf-8")
            args = [] if kind == "none" else [str(path)] + (extra or [])
            proc = run(args)
            results.append({"name": name, "args": args, "wanted_exit": wanted, "exit": proc.returncode,
                            "stderr": proc.stderr.strip(), "ok": proc.returncode == wanted})
    mismatches = [r["name"] for r in results if not r["ok"]]
    report = {"verifier": "claude-v2-final", "ran": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(), "helper": str(HELPER),
              "python": sys.executable, "total": len(results), "mismatches": mismatches, "results": results}
    (ART / "v2-final-adv-cli-probes.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for r in results:
        print(f"{'OK ' if r['ok'] else 'MISMATCH'} {r['name']:36} wanted={r['wanted_exit']} got={r['exit']}")
    print(f"total={len(results)} mismatches={mismatches}")
    return int(bool(mismatches))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
